_comment: Copy to deploy.config.json (gitignored) on the box and fill in. Nothing here is secret except username/password, which is why the real file stays out of git.
_paths: Absolute paths on the box. Backslashes must be doubled -- this is JSON.
_branch: Always the deploy ref -- CI moves it. Do NOT point this at release or dev directly, or staged PRs will never reach the box. See .github/workflows/playwright.yml.
_panelUrl: Hit the panel directly on localhost -- no TLS, no round trip through Caddy.
_credentials: Optional but recommended. Without them the script cannot tell whether Minecraft is running, so it loses its main safety check and will deploy regardless. Needs the 'kill' permission to stop the server when -Force is used.
_pollSeconds: Only used with -Loop. Task Scheduler supplies the interval otherwise.
